name: genudo
description: Genudo — the platform to build AI agents for any communication or sequence-based channel. Pipeline-aware agents with integration capabilities and company-knowledge access, managed from one platform, one inbox, and one analytics dashboard. This plugin builds, edits, automates, and analyzes them from Claude with 20 skills and 6 agents.

token.title: Genudo Token
token.description: From your Genudo account: API Keys & Tokens → Create token, with the mcp:use scope. Shown only once — copy it at creation.

base_url.title: Base URL (advanced)
base_url.description: Only change for a self-hosted Genudo instance.
